specs.title: SCN-001: A customer adds a product to favourites

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer and know an existing product
When I POST /favorites with that product_id
Then the answer is 201 with the favourite's id and the product id

specs.title: SCN-002: Adding a product that is already a favourite is refused

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer with a product in my favourites
When I POST /favorites with the same product_id again
And GET /favorites contains that product exactly once

specs.title: SCN-003: Each customer sees only their own favourites

steps.title: Given customer A has favourited one product and customer B another
When each of them requests GET /favorites
Then A's list has A's favourite and not B's
And B's list has B's favourite and not A's

specs.title: SCN-004.1: The favourites endpoints refuse calls without a valid token (POST /favorites without a token)

steps.title: Given a customer has a favourite
When a client sends POST /favorites without a token

specs.title: SCN-004.2: The favourites endpoints refuse calls without a valid token (GET /favorites without a token)

steps.title: Given a customer has a favourite
When a client sends GET /favorites without a token

specs.title: SCN-004.3: The favourites endpoints refuse calls without a valid token (DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} without a token)

steps.title: Given a customer has a favourite
When a client sends DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} without a token

specs.title: SCN-004.4: The favourites endpoints refuse calls without a valid token (POST /favorites with an invalid token)

steps.title: Given a customer has a favourite
When a client sends POST /favorites with an invalid token

specs.title: SCN-004.5: The favourites endpoints refuse calls without a valid token (GET /favorites with an invalid token)

steps.title: Given a customer has a favourite
When a client sends GET /favorites with an invalid token

specs.title: SCN-004.6: The favourites endpoints refuse calls without a valid token (DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} with an invalid token)

steps.title: Given a customer has a favourite
When a client sends DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} with an invalid token

specs.title: SCN-005: Adding to favourites in the web shop

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer on a product page
[SEED] find the favourite the web shop added
Then I see "Product added to your favorites list."
And the product appears on the "Favorites" page of my account

specs.title: SCN-006: Removing a favourite

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer with a product in my favourites
And GET /favorites no longer contains it
